name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he took a temporary administrative role at a local racing team to pay off student loans. He found himself captivated by the passion and intensity of the racing environment. Soon, he transitioned to a full-time HR position. 

He is a firm believer in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment, understanding that a team's success relies on the well-being and motivation of each individual. His data-driven approach to HR, combined with his natural empathy, allows him to identify potential issues before they escalate and proactively implement solutions. Thabo is known for his ability to mediate conflicts effectively and build strong relationships between team members, ensuring that VW Racing Brasil has a well-rounded and happy team.

physical.description: Thabo is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always has a small tin of biltong on his desk.
Insists on starting every meeting with a brief icebreaker question.
Uses motorsport analogies to explain HR concepts.
